objects.description: Client wrapper around Steamworks interfaces and client engine/remote client manager handles. Manages initialization, shutdown, and callback pumping for a Steam client context, and exposes accessors for key Steamworks interfaces. Details of construction and lifetime are controlled via Init/Shutdown; interface pointers and handles come from Steamworks (not defined here).

Handler class encapsulating Remote Play Together invite flow using Steamworks. Provides methods to send/cancel invites and manage non-Steam AppID/guest ID. Registers Steam callback handlers for stop and invite result events via STEAM_CALLBACK macro. Implementation details are not present in this header.
